name: codeksei
description: Local-first companion bridge for Codex, WeChat, timeline, diary, and review workflows.

scripts.build: npm run build:node && npm run build:web && npm run copy:timeline-assets
scripts.lint: tsx ./src/release/assert-no-authored-js-extensions.ts && tsx ./src/release/assert-published-runtime-artifacts.ts && tsx ./src/release/assert-no-js-tests.ts && tsx ./src/release/assert-no-legacy-branding.ts && tsx ./src/release/assert-no-key-ts-commonjs.ts && tsx ./src/release/assert-no-typed-module-destructure.ts && tsx ./src/release/assert-no-ts-nocheck-regressions.ts && tsx ./src/release/assert-no-empty-catch.ts && tsx ./src/release/assert-no-duplicate-normalize-text.ts && tsx ./src/release/assert-no-redundant-typed-aliases.ts && tsx ./src/release/assert-no-definite-assignment.ts && tsx ./src/release/assert-no-explicit-any.ts && tsx ./src/release/assert-no-core-imports-adapters.ts && tsx ./src/release/assert-no-production-console.ts
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:node && npm run typecheck:web
scripts.typecheck:strict-libs: npm run typecheck:strict-libs:node && npm run typecheck:strict-libs:web && npm run typecheck:strict-libs:tests
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:tests:ts
scripts.coverage:critical: node --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-include=src/core/config.ts --test-coverage-include=src/adapters/channel/weixin/delivery-text.ts --test-coverage-include=src/runtime/runtime-turn-actions.ts --test-coverage-include=src/runtime/runtime-turn-preparation.ts --test-coverage-include=src/runtime/runtime-turn-send.ts --test-coverage-include=src/runtime/runtime-turn-lifecycle.ts --test-coverage-include=src/runtime/stream-delivery.ts --test-coverage-include=src/runtime/stream-delivery/*.ts --test-coverage-lines=88 --test-coverage-branches=75 --test-coverage-functions=85 --experimental-strip-types --require ./tests/helpers/build-path-resolver.ts --test tests/runtime-turn-lifecycle.test.ts tests/app-command-wiring.test.ts tests/app-typing.test.ts tests/weixin-delivery-text.test.ts tests/stream-delivery.test.ts tests/stream-delivery-flush-scheduler.test.ts tests/stream-delivery-transport.test.ts tests/stream-delivery-run-state.test.ts tests/stream-delivery-delta-merge.test.ts tests/stream-delivery-visible-text.test.ts tests/stream-delivery-trace-abandonment.test.ts tests/stream-delivery-reply-target-registry.test.ts tests/branding-config.test.ts tests/config-slices.test.ts
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run coverage:critical && npm run build && npm run test:built-runtime && npm run pack:dry-run
